app.title: Your new app
app.tagline: This is the starting point. Everything you see here is yours to change.
notes.empty: Nothing saved yet. Add the first note below.
sample.notice: You are looking at sample information created for testing. None of it is real, and you can delete it at any time.
error.ownerMissing: We need to know whose notes to show.
error.textTooLong: That note is too long. Please shorten it.
error.saveFailed: That note could not be saved. Please try again.
error.saveUnconfirmed: We could not confirm this save. Check your notes before trying again.
error.storageUnreadable: This app’s information is in an unexpected state, so nothing was changed.
stellar.testMoneyOnly: This fundraiser uses test money, which has no real value.
fundraiser.exampleNote: These numbers are an example. The real ones appear here once this app’s fundraiser is published on Stellar’s test network.
fundraiser.reading: Reading this fundraiser from Stellar’s test network…
example.title: A reading corner for our village school
example.story: Our village school has a spare room and plenty of young readers, but hardly any books for them. We are raising money for shelves, cushions and the first two hundred picture books, so every child has a quiet corner to read in after class. Every donation, however small, brings us closer.
example.updateOne: The school gave us the spare room next to the library.
example.updateTwo: A carpenter from the village offered to build the shelves for the cost of the wood alone.
example.updateThree: The first fifty books arrived, thanks to our earliest supporters.
error.stellarInvalidAddress: That is not a Stellar wallet address. A wallet address starts with G and is 56 characters long.
error.stellarInvalidContractId: The address this app has for its fundraiser is not valid, so the fundraiser cannot be read.
error.stellarInvalidAmount: Enter an amount above zero, with no more than 7 decimal places.
error.stellarUnreachable: Stellar’s test network could not be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.stellarBusy: Stellar’s test network is busy right now. Wait a moment and try again.
error.stellarUnexpectedAnswer: Stellar’s test network sent back an answer this app did not expect. Try again in a moment.
error.stellarNotFunded: This wallet has no test money yet. Get free test money first.
error.stellarDestinationNotFunded: The wallet you are paying has no test money yet, so it cannot receive a payment. Its owner needs to get free test money first.
error.stellarNotEnoughTestMoney: There is not enough test money in this wallet for that.
error.stellarBelowMinimum: That would leave this wallet with less than the small amount Stellar asks every wallet to keep. Try a smaller amount.
error.stellarOpenInBrowser: Your Freighter wallet works in your own browser, not inside this preview. Press “Open in your browser” in Tellop to use it.
error.stellarWalletMissing: Freighter was not found in this browser. Add the Freighter extension, then reload this page.
error.stellarDeclined: You said no in Freighter, so nothing happened.
error.stellarWrongNetwork: Freighter is set to a different Stellar network. Switch it to the test network (Testnet) and try again.
error.stellarWrongAccount: Freighter is using a different account from the one connected here. Switch back to that account, or connect again.
error.stellarWalletError: Freighter ran into a problem. Open Freighter, make sure it is unlocked, and try again.
error.stellarNotATransaction: What came back from the wallet could not be read, so nothing was sent.
error.stellarNotSignedForTestnet: The wallet approved this for a different Stellar network, so nothing was sent. Switch Freighter to the test network (Testnet) and try again.
error.stellarOutOfDate: Something changed in this wallet while you were approving. Try again.
error.stellarExpired: That waited too long for approval and is no longer valid. Try again.
error.stellarFeeTooLow: Stellar’s test network is busy and asked for a higher fee. Try again in a moment.
error.stellarBadSignature: The approval from your wallet did not match this account, so nothing went through.
error.stellarRejected: Stellar’s test network turned this down. Nothing was changed.
error.stellarStillPending: This is taking longer than usual and may still go through. Wait a minute and check again before trying again.
error.stellarContractMissing: This app’s fundraiser was not found on Stellar’s test network. The test network is cleared from time to time; publishing the fundraiser again brings it back.
error.stellarNotAFundraiser: The address this app has for its fundraiser belongs to something else on Stellar’s test network.
error.stellarArchived: Part of this fundraiser’s record on Stellar’s test network was archived after a long quiet spell, so this cannot go ahead right now.
error.stellarContractRefused: The fundraiser turned this down. Nothing was changed.
error.stellarGoalNotPositive: A fundraiser needs a goal above zero.
error.stellarDeadlineInPast: A fundraiser’s end date has to be in the future.
error.stellarEnded: This fundraiser has ended, so it no longer takes donations.
error.stellarNotEnded: This fundraiser has not ended yet. Try again once it has.
error.stellarGoalNotReached: The goal was not reached, so the money cannot be paid out. Supporters can take their donations back instead.
error.stellarGoalReached: The goal was reached, so donations stay with the fundraiser and cannot be taken back.
error.stellarAlreadyWithdrawn: The money has already been paid out.
error.stellarNothingToRefund: There is nothing to give back to this wallet: it made no donation here, or its donation was already returned.
error.stellarOverflow: That amount is too large for this fundraiser.
error.stellarPaused: Donations are paused for now. Try again later.
error.stellarSelfContribution: The fundraiser cannot donate to itself.
error.stellarBeneficiaryIsContract: The fundraiser cannot be set to pay its money to itself.
wallet.title: Your wallet
wallet.intro: Connect your Freighter wallet to get free test money, send it and donate.
wallet.wrongNetwork: Freighter is set to a different Stellar network. Open Freighter, switch it to the test network (Testnet), then press Check again.
wallet.funded: Free test money was added to your wallet.
wallet.sendToHint: A Stellar wallet address, starting with G.
wallet.freighterOpening: Freighter is opening. It can take a few seconds.
wallet.freighterWhere: Don’t see it? Click the Freighter icon at the top right of your browser.
wallet.notPublished: Donations open here once this fundraiser is published on Stellar’s test network.
wallet.yourDonations: You have given {amount} to this fundraiser.
wallet.collectExplain: The goal was reached. Anyone can now send the money on to the person this fundraiser is for, and it can only go to them.
wallet.collected: The money was sent on to the person this fundraiser is for.
wallet.paidOut: The goal was reached and the money has been paid out. Thank you to everyone who gave.
wallet.refundExplain: This fundraiser ended before reaching its goal, so you can take back what you gave: {amount}.
wallet.refunded: Your donation is back in your wallet.
wallet.nothingToRefund: This fundraiser ended before reaching its goal. This wallet has no donation here to take back.
wallet.amountFormat: Write the amount in digits, without separators between thousands, like 1000 or 12.5.
wallet.amountDecimals: Use no more than 7 digits after the decimal point.
